run_test_perspective_n_points: run the test_perspective_n_points method to validate PnP solver accuracy on dense grids and gaussian points
run_test_weighted_perspective_n_points: run the test_weighted_perspective_n_points method to validate PnP solver with 0/1 point weights
test_reproj_error: test the reproj_error function to compute weighted reprojection error between 3D points and 2D projections
test_generate_epnp_test_from_2d: test the _generate_epnp_test_from_2d method to instantiate random x_world, R, T from 2D projections
test_efficient_pnp_solver: test the efficient_pnp solver from pytorch3d.ops.perspective_n_points with skip_quadratic_eq and weights options
